name: TABOR limits and refunds
summary: Colorado should keep TABOR's limits that refund surplus revenue to taxpayers instead of letting the state keep more.
description: The Taxpayer's Bill of Rights caps how much revenue the state can keep and refunds the rest. Proposition NN on this ballot would let the state keep some of it. Supporters of the limits say they restrain government growth; critics say they starve schools and services.
